constraints: The system print dialog it opens configures printer/paper properties only, not the 4D View Pro area's own printing properties, which are set separately with VP SET PRINT INFO; the two should be kept consistent or the printed document may not match expectations.
4D View Pro areas can only be printed with VP PRINT; commands from the 4D Printing language theme are not supported.
Intended for interactive end-user printing; for automated/unattended print jobs, export the area as PDF with VP EXPORT DOCUMENT instead.

sentinelValues.meaning: Explicitly print only the current spreadsheet.
